tests.scope: V19-V23 geometry/color, identity evidence and OCR mocks, automatic ROI/anchor guards, Korean paired assets, copy counts, data integrity/audit/export, one-start Tk workflow, split workers, mocked HTTP; no physical camera or live server

config_check_stdout: V23 config/layouts/camera settings OK: A=12 B=16 C=12 D=64. Hardware/models not opened.
migration: Use the existing dataset root explicitly. V2 ROI/bundles remain readable; V1 bundles need selected-scene rebuild for automatic export. New open-U ROI v3 requires V23.
limitations: Two empty physical board photos validate registration and storage; no claim of perfect vehicle recognition or all-view geometry accuracy.
First registration needs visible names and enough painted-line evidence. Occlusion, glare or low resolution can cause abstention.
Three observed sides and the virtual entrance are separate; calculation polygon is inset 2 source pixels from estimated painted lines.
No trained occupancy or vehicle-mask violation model bundled. Absent sticker without model/reference means unknown, not vacant.
Unchanged floor text suppression is appearance-based and has not been tested across all lighting or partial occlusions.
Final photo geometry regression reused actual CPU OCR cache; cached times are not initial OCR performance measurements.
User stopped computer use with Escape. Final live A/B clicking and all DPI layouts were not visually verified.
No physical camera/GPU/live server/Geti/long-run/real power-cut/OneDrive-concurrency tests.
One writer per dataset. No multiprocess write lock, bulk migration or automatic duplicate-image removal.
Automatic candidates and approved ground truth are separate. Completeness counts do not mean accuracy.
Exports copy and preserve originals; export receipt JSON is separate from the data JSON count.
